parsed.degree_signal: verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Ingenieurinformatik, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
parsed.notes:
“Be our forward thinker” is the qualifications section; none of its items is marked optional. Technologies appearing only under “Make it happen” are excluded.
Generative AI and LLMs collapse to the same taxonomy skill. Containerisierung and its accompanying container orchestration are represented by containerization.
The framework examples are joined by “und”, not offered as alternatives; no alternative group is assigned on this literal reading.
“Fundierte Erfahrung” describes experience depth, not an explicit level or a permitted seniority inference signal.
The comparable field of study broadens the degree subject, not an alternative to holding a degree.
